label: Maximal in a selected perfection, greatest degree, and maxime ens
term: maximal in a selected perfection, greatest degree, and maxime ens
resolution: The case uses the weakest sense: maximal in being, nothing being more a being (`IsMaximumIn InAct MoreIn esse`). It does not assume a strict maximum that exceeds every other being, and it does not use Anselm's conceptual description. Uniqueness is derived (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-AT-MOST-ONE-MAXIME-ENS), not built in. A reviewer who reads 'maxime ens' as 'the greatest possible being' is reading a stronger sense than any premise asserts. Source-attribution correction2026-11-01: AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-MAXIMUM-CAUSES-GENUS-A now supports STMT-GREATEST-DEGREE-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS, using DEF-GREATEST-DEGREE-IN-A-PERFECTION. It does not support the old unrestricted maximality principle I or its fixed-esse instance Iesse. Greatest represented degree allows ties without strict supremacy or uniqueness. The weak maximal abstraction can preserve a weaker existential consequence of greatestness under an appropriate order interpretation (as with H); putting it in an implication antecedent instead strengthens the causal conditional. No old definition, proof premise or formal consequence changes, and no totality or source-to-old-I bridge is supplied. MaximumDefinitionFork registers exact conditional bridges: selected-perfection active-pair strict degree calibration plus local directedness and explicit excluded middle imply maximal-to-greatest, which with the unchanged greatest-degree causal principle yields the exact old selected-esse causal premise. This does not make the old stronger conditional directly sourced. Primitive superlative calibrations distinguish merely maximal, greatest with ties and strict supremacy; named coverage remains OPEN with a selective-tie remainder. Finite incomparable controls block automatic source-to-old-I transfer; tied controls block uniqueness. No global homogeneous being scale is assumed. General-perfection scope: DEF-MAXIMUM-IN-A-PERFECTION quantifies at a supplied respect r; maxime ens specializes r to esse. Reuse the same distinction for general maximality and GreatestDegreeBearer, holding the active domain and selected respect fixed. MoreIn need not represent an order or a degree comparison; the #1141 calibration/directedness bridges and finite countermodels are essential, not implicit in the words maximum or greatest. Sense fork (batch 3, #1233 B; docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md): the quarta via's last step uses the superlative twice (something is maxime ens; what is maxime in being causes being in all others). Its readings are three senses, each its own declaration: MAXIME_1 = DEF-MAXIME-ENS (IsMaximalIn at esse), MAXIME_2 = DEF-GREATEST-DEGREE-IN-A-PERFECTION (GreatestDegreeBearer at esse), MAXIME_3 = DEF-GREATEST-BEING-STRICT (StrictlyGreatestIn at esse). Coverage STMT-MAXIME-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE and exclusivity STMT-MAXIME-SENSE-UNIQUE are OPEN premises. At the root-route node STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-BEINGS (the causal principle at being, MAXIMAL antecedent) the per-sense arguments are MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-AS-MAXIMAL, the existing MAXIMAL-BEING-CAUSES-FROM-GREATEST-DEGREE (MAXIME_2) and MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-AS-STRICTLY-GREATEST, the last through the bridge STMT-MAXIMAL-IN-BEING-IS-STRICTLY-GREATEST (derived from STMT-MORE-IN-BEING-CONNECTED). At the quarta via's existential conclusion STMT-MAXIME-ENS-CAUSES-BEING-OF-ALL, which no root argument consumes yet, the per-sense arguments MAXIME-ENS-CAUSES-ALL-AS-MAXIMAL, -AS-GREATEST-DEGREE and -AS-STRICTLY-GREATEST conclude it; MAXIME_2 and MAXIME_3 pass to the MAXIMAL conclusion only through the explicit sense bridges STMT-GREATEST-IN-BEING-IS-MAXIMAL (derived from STMT-MORE-IN-BEING-TRACKS-DEGREE) and STMT-STRICTLY-GREATEST-IN-BEING-IS-MAXIMAL (derived from STMT-MORE-IN-IS-ASYMMETRIC). Summary MAXIME-SENSE-FORK-CAUSES-BEING-OF-ALL; TERM-SENSE-FORKS-3-CONTROLS shows the mixed reading (existence MAXIMAL, causal GREATEST-degree) fails. Not senses of this use: DEF-GREATEST-CONCEIVABLE-BEING (Anselm's conceptual description; no root statement uses it, and a rival who reads the quarta via so denies coverage), DEF-MAXIMUM-CALIBRATION-PROFILE (bridge vocabulary relating the senses, not a reading) and DEF-MAXIMUM-IN-A-PERFECTION (MAXIME_1's declaration at a general respect).
